evidence.reason: Documented contract only, not measured: wrangler is not installed on this machine and this project never installs a CLI for the user. The page (last updated Jul 14, 2026) states that re-running with --temporary deploys before authentication and prints a claim URL, that the intended user must COMPLETE the claim within 60 minutes, and that Workers Static Assets on a temporary account are limited to 1,000 files with each asset up to 5 MiB. The per-deploy deadline is printed at run time, so claimDeadline is null here rather than guessed.

notes: Not measured: whether an assets-only Worker (no script) deploys this way, the served host, HTML injection, byte fidelity of the assets, and reachability from mainland China. Cloudflare documents a separate China Network product, so no mainland claim is made from this page.
